Included

Everything in the base rate

Manage workspace keys, balances, usage, and generated-file archives in the dashboard.

  • Unlimited API keys, each with its own budget and scopes
  • Asynchronous video tasks with status polling
  • Workspace channel, model-access, and member-role management
  • Workspace balance and usage history

Video task reservations

A confirmed failed video task releases its reserved balance. An unresolved upstream task remains reserved until reconciled.

Configured model rates

Charges use the rates configured for the workspace's enabled model channels.

Redeem-code balance

Workspace administrators can add credit by redeeming a code issued for the account.

Usage visibility

Review workspace balances, reservations, and usage records in the dashboard.

Building something large?

For high-volume workloads, contact the service operator to discuss available options.
